analogy.rationale: AHR is a ligand-activated transcription factor, so its agonists act like other nuclear receptor agonists (CAR, FXR, LXR, PPAR, VDR) that induce overlapping xenobiotic/detoxification and metabolic gene programs; however, AHR expression is low in most of these cell lines, so the response is expected to be weak.
